body:
maya: Staging rollout for ff/prefetch-coalesce-v3 starting now. Plan: enable 5% staging shard, monitor p95 latency & 1-minute error rate, then expand. Anyone on infra can validate batching behavior?

chris: I'll run perf capture and check KV cache hit ratio. Ping me when flag flips.

tomas: Do we have a metric to detect degraded tail latency from batching? Suggest track per-model p99 and grpc queue depth.

jenny: On it. Also confirm rollback button is wired to set ff to "off" for all envs. If not, we should have playbook.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: pref-coalesce-v3 -> staging (5%). Task id: DPL-8291.

maya: Quick config snippet to enable:
```json
{
  "flag": "ff/prefetch-coalesce-v3",
  "env": "staging",
  "audience": "percentage:5"
}
```

chris: Running:
`curl -X POST https://internal-api/flags/ff/prefetch-coalesce-v3?env=staging -d 'percent=5' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
I'll post perf snapshots in ~10m.

tomas: Canary audience: use shard keys "team=prod-sim" and "region=us-west-2" to mimic production tail.

jenny: Also ensure KV prefetch logging is sampled at 100% for this shard:
`export PREFETCH_LOG_SAMPLE=1.0`
We should correlate request_id->kv_hit.

maya: Who can own immediate rollback? @chris?

chris: I can roll back. Plan:
- step1: set flag to 0% for staging
- step2: restart prefetch workers on staging nodes that have new behavior (graceful)
- step3: clear in-memory prefetch caches if necessary
I'll run step1 if p95 increases > 40ms or errors > 0.5%.

oncall: FYI, set escalation to eng-oncall if >2 services show >1% errors. I'll watch alerts.

jenny: Also file quick PR to add a route to console for "force disable prefetch ff" — small UI guard.

maya: Code review pinged: https://phab/redwood/D12345
Please +1 if you can review quickly.

chris: perf snapshot: p95 unchanged, p99 down 3ms, kv_hit +12%. No errors. I'll hold expansion to 20% tomorrow 9am PT.

tomas: Add traffic-slicing note to runbook so dedicated capacity isn't auto-bursting into staging nodes.

maya: Thanks. I'll update runbook and tag deploy notes. Rolling expansion tomorrow unless anyone flags.

jenny: lgtm from security side — no data leakage on prefetch keys.

infra-bot: Monitoring alert rule created: pref_coalesce_staging_p95_watch. Threshold 40ms.

maya: tagging participants for visibility: @chris @tomas @jenny @oncall :thumbsup:
